mechanism_narrative: A higher level of housing starts (HOUST) reflects robust consumer demand for new homes, which signals strong economic activity and predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST is above its 12-month average, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 4.5%, it signals a tightening monetary policy that increases discount rates for equities, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both labor market strength (PAYEMS) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicates a broad-based economic slowdown, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances where both PAYEMS and INDPRO decline month-over-month, or the Rank IC for the interaction is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, a rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses equity valuations through higher discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances during monetary tightening cycles when FEDFUNDS rises, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window within tightening cycles.

mechanism_narrative: A lower unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a tight labor market and strong economic activity, which predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE is below 4.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1900.0 thousand units, it signals a contraction in the housing market, which predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST < 1900.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in inflation (CPIAUCSL) and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates an aggressive monetary policy response to rising inflation, which compresses equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances where both CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS rise month-over-month, or the Rank IC for the interaction is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals the onset of economic slowdown, which predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances during late-cycle expansions when INDPRO declines, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window within late-cycle expansions.
